title: Filed Driver Rating Plan: Age Class of a Reported Resident Listed Before Exclusion (Owner Auto Policy)
content:
**Age-class relativity.** Under the company's filed driver rating plan, an age-class relativity multiplies the listing share of a household resident who is listed on the Owner Auto Policy and then excluded. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent.

The age is the driver's age in whole years on the rating date, which is the report date of the claim report recording the resident operating as an unlisted household resident.
- The date of birth is taken from the resident's most recent entry on the term.
- A year is complete on the birthday.
- A 29 February birthday completes on 1 March in a year with no 29 February.

| Age on the rating date | Relativity |
|---|---|
| under 21 | 1.85 |
| at least 21 and under 25 | 1.35 |
| 25 or older | 1 |
| no such entry on the term | 1 |

**Both sides of each boundary (hypothetical rating date of 10 June).**
- Born 11 June, 21 years earlier: still 20 on the rating date, so 1.85.
- Born 10 June, 21 years earlier: 21 on the rating date, so 1.35.
- Born 10 June, 25 years earlier: 25, so 1.
- Born 29 February with the twenty-first birthday falling in a common year: 21 is reached on 1 March.
